name: high_temp_heat_pump_r245fa
title: Simple R245fa high-temperature heat pump (T_ev 80 C / T_cd 145 C)
summary: Subcritical vapour-compression high-temperature heat pump on R245fa lifting water from 95 C to 120 C: imposed cycle conditions (evaporation at 80 C, condensation at 145 C, 5 K superheat/subcooling, isentropic efficiency 0.6) with recomputed 10-node water-side temperature profiles and a pinch check on both exchangers.

verification.summary: The source script nghp/simple HTHP model.py (S. Quoilin, MIT) and its hx() function were re-run in a venv (CoolProp 8.0.0) and 127 of its values (8 state points, 3 mass flows, 2 pinches, water end temperatures, 10-node profiles, duties) compared with the CoolSolve .sol: max rel diff 2.3e-09 (CoolProp backend version only).
verification.reference: Re-run of nghp/simple HTHP model.py @ 6db23af in a Python 3.12 venv with CoolProp 8.0.0 (IPython reset line removed from a copy, MPLBACKEND=Agg)
verification.notes: The venv pip CoolProp 8.0.0 vs the pinned CoolProp 8.1.0dev of the CoolSolve build; no variable excluded from the comparison.
